label: Slack: Delete Message
description: Delete a message this app posted earlier (Slack only lets an app delete its own messages). Address it by channel + ts.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Slack access (wire a SlackAccess node). Needs the chat:write scope.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.label: Channel
inputs.placeholder: The channel id the message lives in

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the message is gone.
